newsitem.title: USA: Continucare buys three medical practices.
newsitem.headline: Continucare buys three medical practices.

text.p: Continucare Corp said Friday it has acquired three south Florida physician practices from Sheridan Healthcare Inc for about $3.6 million in cash.
Continucare said the three practices are Norman Gaylis M.D. Inc, Weitz & Ritter M.D. and Arthritis and Rhuematic Disease Specialties Inc.
Continucare said the combined practices generated about $4 million in revenues in 1996.

The company said it will integrate these medical practices into some rehabilitation centers in South Florida owned by Bally Total Fitness Holdings Corp. In February, the company signed a management agreement with Bally to provide physical rehabilitation services in up to 100 health clubs.
